arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test current behavior
utc = parse.FixedTzOffset(0, 'UTC')
aest = parse.FixedTzOffset(10 * 60, '+1000')
tz60 = parse.FixedTzOffset(60, '+01:00')

print('UTC:', repr(utc))
print('AEST:', repr(aest))
print('tz60:', repr(tz60))

# Check if tz name is normalized or kept as-is
r = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 +01:00')
print('Parsed tzinfo:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo)
print('tzinfo name:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo.tzname(None))
print('tzinfo offset:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo.utcoffset(None))
"
